cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put red labels on the boxes like you. Ready to go. Let me help; missing your birthday can't mean you never trust me again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Red means fragile. I haven't decided to trust you with those.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, extra care. Give me one box and I'll carry it myself all the way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Those are the birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep that box with me. Could we unwrap two at your new place?
